aggregation.supply: Blood unit records counted per donor blood group per month of BloodDonation.startTime (UTC)
aggregation.demand: Request.unitsRequired summed per blood group per month of Request.createdAt (UTC)
aggregation.wastage: Blood units with disposed=true or (consumed=false and expiryDate passed), attributed to the month of the unit's expiryDate (UTC)
aggregation.zero_rows: months inside the observed span with no records carry a real count of 0 (absence of records, not estimation)
